name: Retret
tagline: The operating system for executive offsites and leadership retreats.
positioning: Retret helps enterprise People and Chief of Staff teams plan, run, and measure high-stakes offsites — from venue sourcing to post-event ROI reporting.

hero.h1: Every offsite, executed like a board meeting.
hero.sub: Retret gives People and Chief of Staff teams a single system to source venues, manage attendee logistics, and prove the business impact of leadership offsites.

features.title: Governed venue sourcing
features.description: Compare vetted venues, pull negotiated rates, and route contracts through legal and procurement without leaving a single record trail.

features.title: Attendee logistics at scale
features.description: Coordinate travel, dietary needs, accessibility, and room blocks for 20 to 2,000 attendees with automated approvals and change tracking.

features.title: Agenda intelligence
features.description: Build outcome-driven agendas from proven templates, then align every session to the strategic objective it's meant to advance.

features.title: Budget reconciliation
features.description: Track committed, spent, and forecasted cost per offsite in real time, with line-item exports for finance and audit.

features.title: Post-event ROI reporting
features.description: Capture pulse surveys, engagement signals, and follow-through on action items to quantify the return on every gathering.

features.title: Enterprise compliance
features.description: SOC 2 Type II, SSO/SCIM, data residency, and duty-of-care travel tracking built for regulated organizations.

testimonials.quote: We ran 14 regional leadership offsites last year on Retret. For the first time, our CFO could see cost-per-attendee and follow-through on strategic actions in one report.
testimonials.name: Marielle Danforth

testimonials.quote: Sourcing a venue for 600 sales leaders used to take my team six weeks. With Retret's negotiated inventory and contract routing, it took nine days.
testimonials.name: Devon Iyer

testimonials.quote: The duty-of-care tracking alone justified the investment. During a weather disruption we knew where every executive was within minutes.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan
